protocol.order: all/parameters for even seed-list positions; reverse for odd positions; expanded reverses at seed1234

convergence_screening.confirmation: two adjacent passing snapshots; earlier unobserved crossings are possible

protocol.limitations: Quality gates are not relaxed after outcomes. Exact warm fixed-weight gradients are checked separately from cold-call repeatability. Expanded study has only two seeds and does not promote expanded lifting to default. Unsupported mixed precision, MPS and multiple devices are not accepted.

numerical-reports/backward-convergence-0.limitations: Only L-BFGS snapshots after completed Adam. Two adjacent successes required. Snapshot I/O overhead included in wall times and reported separately; no interpolation. Analytical evaluation follows all optimizer steps within each trial, never changes training or stopping. Physical autograd used independently of derivative executor. Final warm inference is measured separately.

numerical-reports/backward-gauss-robin-s.limitations: Independent Gauss quadratures; normal coordinate derivatives in the hard field remain active. Near-orthogonality and reconstruction checked; quadrature is an estimate, not a certified continuous error bound. Query coordinates use FP32.

numerical-reports/backward-profiler-capa.note: CUDA table timings can exist via fallback even if Chrome trace lacks CUDA kernel events; missing trace events do not establish zero launches/transfers.

numerical-reports/backward-state-equival.limitations: CPU comparison of saved state values; wall-time metrics and requested backward hyperparameter deliberately excluded. No training, inference or GPU operations.

numerical-reports/backward-trace-summary.limitations: Profiler diagnostic pass only; kernel sums are not an additive wall-time decomposition. Not optimizer or data-loader profiling.

_storage.table_format: CSV table + row indexes; JSON-encoded scalar cells, dot-separated nested column names. See docs/numerical-benchmarks.md.
